headline: Plans for the November 17 IRIS event and a December 10 Human Rights Day game night.

TOWN OF HAMDEN, 
CONNECTICUT 
 
HUMAN RIGHTS & RELATIONS 
COMMISSION 
 
REGULAR MEETING AGENDA 
 
7:00 PM, NOVEMBER 12, 2026 
 
 
Hamden Government 
Center 
Third Floor Conference 
Room 
2750 Dixwell Avenue 
Hamden, CT  06518 
Tel:  (203) 287-7070 
Fax:  (203) 287-7075 
 
Meeting Agenda: The Human Rights & Relations Commission, Town of Hamden, will 
hold a Regular Meeting on Thursday, November 12, 2026 at 7:00 PM via zoom and in-
person at the Third Floor Conference Room in the Hamden Government Center at 2750 
Dixwell Avenue. Please note that the webinar link is different from previously used links for 
this meeting. 
 
Webinar Link: https://hamden.zoom.us/j/88517051494 
 
Join via audio: 
+1 309 205 3325 US 
Webinar ID: 885 1705 1494 
 
 
This meeting is hybrid, held both in person and virtually.  
1. CALL TO ORDER 
 
2. ATTENDANCE 
 
3. PUBLIC COMMENT 
 
  1. Alexis Smith of New Haven Legal Assistance to inform the Commission on legal 
services available and answer questions. 
4. APPROVAL OF PREVIOUS MEETING MINUTES 
 
  1. Approval of September and October Minutes.  
5. CORRESPONDENCE 
There will be a brief summary of the correspondence submitted between the last 
correspondence update and this one. This includes but is not limited to any 
correspondence with council members that members wish to submit for the record. It can 
also include written communication to the council from the administration, community 
members, etc.  
  1. RSVPs to November 17 IRIS Event.
6. REPORTS 
 
  1. Social media posts for November 17 events 
  2. Commission Applications. 
7. OLD BUSINESS 
 
  1. November 17 IRIS Event details 
8. NEW BUSINESS 
 
  1. December 10 Human Rights Day "Game Night" Details. 
  2. Subsequent Cancelation of December 10 Meeting. 
  3. Discuss and Approve Poster for Event. 
9. ADJOURNMENT 
 
  
NOTE: The public may address any item on the agenda of a regular or special meeting and any 
matter within the purview of a Board or Commission at a regular meeting either electronically or 
in person, unless otherwise set forth or constrained by Law of the provisions of this Charter.
